messages:
maya_marketing: Ok team — quick improv sprint. Need a trimmed set of launch-ready claims + 3 field scripts for SDRs that contrast Redwood vs cloud AI endpoints + LLM API players. Focus: benchmarks (latency/econ), reliability fallbacks, and private deploys. Can everyone drop 1–2 lines by EOD? :running:
tom_sales: Love it. Two quick claims: 'predictable p99 latency at scale' and 'unit economics you can model — not guess.' For SDR scripts: short opener + demo hook. Example: 
```
SDR: 'Hi — we help dev teams cut inference cost by up to 40% through smarter batching & caching. Quick 10-min demo?'
```
jana_product: Add: 'unified runtime across hosted, dedicated, and private' and 'automatic fallbacks to compatible model variants during capacity spikes' — those hit infra teams. Also add a one-liner about "no vendor lock-in" for model rollouts.
ethan_growth: For the benchmark narrative: show apples-to-apples test vs CloudA managed endpoints and Generic LLM API. We should lead with: '1M tokens at Xms avg, Y% lower cost' (fill numbers after infra confirms). Webinar angle: "How we cut token cost without sacrificing latency" — real customer case + live Q&A.
maya_marketing: @ethan noted — can we avoid raw % claims until infra signs off? Use ranges like 'up to' and emphasize reproducible tests. Also we need two quick objection responses: procurement (SLA/enterprise), and engineers (integration effort).
tom_sales: Objection scripts: 
- Procurement: 'We offer reserved capacity + SLA backed SLAs and an enterprise onboarding checklist.'
- Engineer: 'Same API across modes, SDKs in your stack, and migration guide + sample infra repo.'
olivia_legal: Quick legal check: please avoid 'guarantee' language. 'Reduce' / 'help cut' / 'up to' are fine. Also don't cite specific competitor product names in claims slides — use category references (e.g., "cloud managed endpoints").
jana_product: For the battlecard quick matrix, suggest 3 axes: Economics, Latency Guarantees, Deployment Flexibility. One-liners under each for Redwood vs Cloud vs API-only. I'll sketch and drop later.
maya_marketing: Beautiful. @sales_ops_bot can you paste the latest matrix so we avoid duplication? :pray:
sales_ops_bot: Latest matrix here: https://internal.redwood/docs/field/matrix-v2 (updated 1719100000)
ethan_growth: Quick content for webinar slide headline: 'Serving-first inference: predictable latency, reproducible cost.' Keep it short. Also test question to panel: 'How do you decide when to quantize vs use more caching?' Very tactical.
tom_sales: Two 10–15s soundbites for sales deck: 'Redwood gives infra teams a single runtime that scales predictably' and 'We lower per-token spend through caching & smarter batching — not black-box savings.'
maya_marketing: Action items: 
- @jana_product: rough battlecard matrix + 3 one-liners by EOD
- @tom_sales: 3 SDR script variants (SaaS, Enterprise, Platform) by EOD
- @ethan_growth: webinar headline + 3 benchmark framing bullets (no numbers) by tomorrow AM
- @olivia_legal: quick pass on copy by tomorrow noon
I'll assemble a trimmed 1-pager for the launch post. Thanks everyone :rocket:
